title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-exp

translated_title: LIBERO-PeRM：个性化机器人操作基准测试
translated_abstract: 个性化对于通用机器人进入家庭环境并实现真正实用性至关重要。尽管通用机器人操作已被广泛研究，但个性化机器人操作缺乏一个受控基准来将任务完成与偏好满足区分开来。我们提出了LIBERO-PeRM，一个面向具身智能体偏好学习的基准。LIBERO-PeRM研究了五个问题：1）策略在零样本设置下如何遵循偏好；2）策略如何从演示中学习单一偏好；3）随着演示数量增加，策略获取偏好的效率如何；4）学到的偏好如何在不同布局和任务之间泛化；5）策略如何组合偏好以及在偏好发生冲突时的行为表现。我们提出了一个受控的形式化框架和仿真中可观察偏好的分类体系，涵盖运动、技能和用户档案三个方面的选择。该形式化框架仅限于语言明确表达的偏好……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LIBERO-PeRM基准，通过受控形式化框架和涵盖运动、技能与用户档案的可观察偏好分类体系，从零样本偏好遵循、演示学习效率、跨布局跨任务泛化以及偏好组合与冲突处理五个方面系统评估具身智能体的个性化机器人操作能力。
en_tdlr: LIBERO-PeRM introduces a controlled benchmark with a taxonomy of observable preferences spanning motion, skill, and user-profile choices, systematically evaluating embodied agents' personalized robotic manipulation across five questions: zero-shot preference following, preference learning from demonstrations, sample efficiency, generalization across layouts and tasks, and preference composition and conflict resolution.
